Name: Delaiah
Summary: Delaiah, son of Shemaiah, was a prince of Jehoiakim's court who heard Jeremiah's roll and joined the princes pleading with the king not to burn it.
KeyStory: Delaiah sat among the princes who heard the roll and besought the king that he would not burn it, but the king would not hear.
RelatedPeople: Jeremiah; Baruch; Jehoiakim, King of Judah
LifeLesson: A plea refused is still a plea made — God records the dissent, not only the decree.
